description: THE SELL-SIDE READ: is the case for a name you already hold still intact, or deteriorating? Returns published trend state, the hold label, maturity-late flag, overnight gap-risk level, the book's regime, and watch_flags: which deterioration conditions are TRUE right now (structure light off green, leadership lost, mature leg, trend cold, high gap risk, earnings within 7 trading days), plus the mechanical rules those states flip on. BTC-USD / ETH-USD return the crypto IN|CASH daily-close state. Up to 3 comma-separated symbols. Reports conditions only; impersonal, it never reads your entry, size or account. Free sample: up to 3 symbols per call, headline fields, one market day delayed.

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. NVDA — or up to 3 comma-separated (NVDA,AMD,BTC-USD)
